description: Biological-I/O port indices for Experiment 6 (CX analogue of Exp 4). npz keys 'cx_full__sub_rows' index the 7349-row CX adjacency; 'cx_full__<port>' index the substrate's own 0..N-1 space. Port names reuse the MB engine's keys (alpn/kc/mbon/dan/mbin); CX role mapping below.

role_map.alpn(input): heading+landmark/ring sensory: EPG, ER*, ExR, TuBu, LNO/GLNO, SpsP, IbSpsP
role_map.kc(hidden): FB/PB integration: hDelta*, vDelta*, FC*, PEN*, PEG*, FB*, FR*, EL, P6, PFG
role_map.mbon(output): steering/FB premotor output: PFL*, PFR*, FS*
role_map.dan(teaching): PFN* -- instructive self-motion; DISANALOGY: no dopaminergic teaching population exists in the CX (see build_cx_ports docstring / lab notebook)

notes: CX is hemibrain -> cell types from neurons.csv['type'] (FlyWire root_id join does NOT apply).
All three connectomes/cx_* adjacency_unsigned.npz are byte-identical raw CX wiring.
Prior repo CX I/O precedent: run_cx_steering.py (EPG in, PFL3 out); report_pool_fidelity.py regexes.
